alternatives.option: extend twining_unarchive to restore blackboard entries

context: Adversarial review round 1: three confirmed defects in the D1-D5 fixes, all fixed — archive_stale now tombstones dismissed blackboard entries and states honestly that unarchive restores decisions only; auto-archive trigger and fired sweep share NO_AGE_CUTOFF (clock-skew #35 variant closed); twining_status needs_archiving computed from the archive partition instead of the raw count
rationale: restoring from tombstones needs an id-collision-safe re-append path that deserves its own design; honest text plus a full-content tombstone removes the data-loss-behind-a-recoverability-promise today
summary: Chose to tombstone archive_stale's blackboard dismissals and correct the tool text rather than extend twining_unarchive to restore blackboard entries
